mathura-2022.notes: Source 2 lists 146 teams and source 3 (144 teams) differ; the on-site page has 15 ranked and 131 Honorable Mention rows. Source 4 was catalogued as rankings but is a team list (selected and waiting-list teams) without results.

sources.evidence: The pages are headed ICPC Mathura-Kanpur Site and give dates, registration, people, contact and results of the 2023 on-site round and the preliminary online contest.
Page titled Result of Mathura-Kanpur Onsite Round with a table of 15 ranked teams followed by 131 unranked Honorable Mention teams.
Table of 144 ranked rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation under the heading The 2022 ICPC Asia Mathura Kanpur Regional Contest.
Page titled Result of Preliminary Online Contest holds tables of team name, institute and on-site city for 151 selected teams and a waiting list of 15, with no scores or ranks.
20-page PDF titled Mathura - Kanpur Contest Problems (11 Problems), 09th April, 2023, with Problems A to K.
Byte-identical to source 5 (cmp finds no difference), a 20-page PDF with Problems A to K.
